decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered Design and Access Statement (as amended by the documents below), Received 2 December 2011, Sound Insulation Assessment, Received 23 February 2012, Email MZA Associates, Received 6 March 2012, Additional Noise Information via Email, Received 27 April 2012 approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 2 - The restaurant shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 9.00am to 11.00pm Monday to Saturday, and 9.00am to 10.00pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays. No customers shall remain on the premises 30 minutes after this time.

Condition : 3 - The existing ventilation unit shall be upgraded, the air conditioning unit replaced and mitigation measures detailed in the Noise Assessment (Received 23 February 2012) shall be implemented and completed within three months of the date of this decision. 
The consent holder shall provide the Local Planning Authority with written evidence that the works have been completed within three months of the date of this decision.
Condition : 4 - The restaurant use shall be operated in accordance with the measures detailed in the Noise Assessment (Received 23 February 2012) and the Email (dated 27 April 2012) at all times.

Condition : 5 - The rear door (onto the alley way) shall be fitted with a self closer and this shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order. The rear door shall remain closed except when opened to take refuse and recycling to the rear of the premises.
Condition : 6 - The area between the front wall of the premises and the edge of Devonshire Road shall not be used for outdoor seating, dining or drinking.
Condition : 7 - There shall be no speakers or stereo system affixed to the party walls or ceiling within the premises at any stage.
Condition : 8 - No additional fans, louvers, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Variation of Condition 1 of planning permission 00354/38/P7 for the continued use of the premises as (A3) restaurant at ground floor to vary the permitted opening hours from 9.00am to 7.30pm Monday - Saturday and not on Sundays or Bank Holidays to 09:00am to 11.00pm Monday - Saturday and 09:00am to 22:00pm on Sunday, Public and Bank Holidays. All customers shall have left the premises no later than 30 minutes after the closing times listed above.
